* Primary Key
* Composite Primary Key
* Normalization
* Indexes
* Difference between Left Join and Inner Join

### 2. SQL Queries:

* Retrieve the top 5 employees with the highest salary from an employee table.
* Retrieve the name of the employee with the maximum and minimum salary.

After a week, I got the result — I had cleared the round. But there was a surprise: out of around 1,700 students, only 254 from my college moved forward.

That was honestly shocking. The competition had suddenly become much tougher.

### Round 3: Deep Skill Training

After clearing the coding round, all selected candidates entered Deep Skill Training, which worked like a pre-training program.

I was assigned to the Java cluster, which had around 17 modules covering topics such as Java development, design principles, Docker, Git, Cloud, and more.

The training lasted around 50 days. Cognizant conducted weekly classes, but our college also provided additional classes, which were really helpful. We also had to complete the assigned courses and upload our assignments to GitHub.

### Round 4: Deep Skill Assessment

The assessment was conducted on 31 July. It had 100 questions with a 2-hour time limit and covered the topics from the Deep Skill training.

Overall, I found it fairly easy. The results came the next day, and only 14 students were eliminated.

After clearing this round, I received my interview schedule for 10 August.

* Self-introduction

* Project explanation
* Java coding — string reversal

* React
